english: Let $A(0,1)$ and $B(0,3)$ be two points and let $P(x,0)$, $x>2$, be a point on the $x$-axis. The angle $\theta=\angle APB$ is measured as $\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)$ with a possible error of $0.002$ radian. Using differentials, the approximate magnitude of the resulting error in the value of $x$ computed from $\theta$ is
hindi: माना कि $A(0,1)$ तथा $B(0,3)$ दो बिन्दु हैं और $P(x,0)$, $x>2$, $x$-अक्ष पर एक बिन्दु है। कोण $\theta=\angle APB$ को $\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)$ मापा गया है, जिसमें $0.002$ रेडियन की सम्भावित त्रुटि है। अवकलों का उपयोग करके, $\theta$ से परिकलित $x$ के मान में उत्पन्न त्रुटि का सन्निकट परिमाण है
solution_full: With $O$ the origin, $\angle OPB=\tan^{-1}\dfrac{3}{x}$ and $\angle OPA=\tan^{-1}\dfrac{1}{x}$ (right triangles $OPB$, $OPA$), and $\theta=\angle OPB-\angle OPA$.

Measured value: $\dfrac{2x}{x^{2}+3}=\dfrac{1}{2}\Rightarrow x^{2}-4x+3=0\Rightarrow x=1$ or $x=3$. Both positions see the same angle (they are on opposite sides of $x=\sqrt3$, where $\theta$ is largest); the condition $x>2$ selects $x=3$.
At $x=3$: right side $=\dfrac{2(3-9)}{144}=-\dfrac{1}{12}$, and $\sec^{2}\theta=1+\dfrac14=\dfrac54$. So $\dfrac{d\theta}{dx}=-\dfrac{1}{12}\cdot\dfrac45=-\dfrac{1}{15}$, i.e. $dx=-15\,d\theta$.
Check of the trap: at $x=1$, $\dfrac{d\theta}{dx}=\dfrac{2\cdot 2}{16}\cdot\dfrac45=\dfrac15$ and $|dx|=0.01$, which is option (A); it is excluded by $x>2$.
originality_note: New: error propagation from a measured viewing angle back to the observer's distance, with two positions giving the same angle (way 5). Closest known: the angle subtended by a segment and its maximum at x = sqrt(ab). Different because: the inverse error dx = d(theta)/theta'(x) is asked, and the branch must be chosen from the data (x > 2).

concept_use.Approximation and errors using different: dx = d(theta) / (d theta/dx) gives the error 15 x 0.002 = 0.03.
concept_use.Compound angles: sin(A+/-B), cos(A+/-B),: tan(theta) = tan(OPB - OPA) = 2x/(x^2+3) by the tan(A-B) formula.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol, curve and function introduced with its domain; conditions complete; one reading of each sentence; answer unique and equal to the plan (Option B); Hindi mirrors the English maths. Checked both x = 1 and x = 3 give the angle; x > 2 selects one, so the error is unique. No change.
key_step: Write tan(theta) by tan(A-B), pick the correct one of the two positions x = 1, 3, and invert the differential.
justification: Two ideas linked (compound-angle model and inverse error estimate) plus a branch decision whose wrong choice is an offered option; this matches the L3 trig-evaluation anchor 2024-P1-Q3 rather than the one-move L1 items.
